story.lede: Before the brand, there was the factory. Vit Makanan (K.L.) Sdn. Bhd. has made noodles in Kuala Lumpur since 1975, halal certified since 1980, and quietly feeds a country that knows the yellow pack by sight.

tiles.body: The family starts making noodles in Kuala Lumpur. The phoenix goes on the first wrapper.
Halal certified by JAKIM. 46 years unbroken, with preferential access across the Gulf.
Of revenue is the Malaysian plain noodle base. The home market is served first, always.
Of export experience across dozens of markets.
A year on the world circuit. Dubai first, then the United States, Bangkok and the UK.

story.footNote: Dates as published by Vit's. Final verification before anything goes to print or page.
